title: Averardo de' Medici and Piero Guicciardini, Faenza, to the Dieci di Balìa, 27 October 1425: the cipher part Albizzi's embassy could not read (ASF, Dieci di Balìa, Responsive 1425; copy in Guasti, Commissioni II pp. 457-458)

documents.shelfmark: ASF, Dieci di Balìa, Responsive, filza for October 1425 (number not yet identified); clear part copied in Rinaldo degli Albizzi's register, printed by Guasti, Commissioni di Rinaldo degli Albizzi II (1869) pp. 457-458
documents.route: Faenza -> Florence (forwarded to the Florentine embassy in Rome and returned)

plaintext.source: The register copy printed by Guasti gives the clear opening and stops at 'Quanto più pensiamo etc. quia multa sunt ciferata, nobis ignota'. No decipherment known.

transcription.notes: No image of the letter is online. DECODE's 32 Dieci Responsive records (filze 2, 3, 7, 8, 9, 22) were all viewed; none is of 1425. ASF's image server (PAD/MAP) was unreachable on 24 Sept 2026, and the Dieci Responsive are not among the fonds PAD digitised.

system.summary: Unknown: only the clear part of the letter survives in print. By date and office it is probably a Dieci commissioner cipher of the kind rebuilt for Galeotto Fibindacci da Ricasoli in 1424 (homophonic signs, nulls, small nomenclator), but no sign of it has been seen.
system.notes: symbol_kind, key_order and word_division are the norm for Florentine Dieci ciphers of 1424-30 (florence1429, Gabbrielli's key volume), not observations of this letter.

prior_solution.where: No decipherment in Guasti or elsewhere; Gabbrielli's key volume (Ilardi reel 58) has no key for 1425-29.

conditions.human_role: Set the goal (decipher the letter). The DECODE session cookie on disk from earlier sessions was used to fetch the Dieci images. No images of the target supplied.
tools: DECODE API metadata dump and live list

solution.what: Read Guasti, Commissioni II pp. 457-458 (archive.org djvu text): the Dieci sent the commissioners' letter of 27 Oct 1425 to the Rome embassy and asked for it back; the register copies the clear opening and notes 'quia multa sunt ciferata, nobis ignota'. The cipher runs from 'Quanto più pensiamo' to the date.

Searched the DECODE metadata dump (10,106 records) and the live list (newest R10198) for Florence, Dieci, Averardo, Faenza, Guicciardini: only Dieci Responsive 2, 3, 7, 8, 9, 22 are on DECODE. Fetched and viewed all 32 images of R3758-R3789: filza 7 = 1424 Visconti letters, filza 8 = 1430 (Fibindacci, Pontremoli; R3765 is the decipherment of R3766), filza 9 = 1431 clear letters of Averardo and of the Ridolfi-Medici embassy, filza 22 = later. None is the Faenza letter.

Checked Gabbrielli's key volume (Ilardi reel 58, as filmed for florence1429): keys for 1424 (pp. 1-4) and 1430 (pp. 5-9) only; the filmed sender index covers A-B only, so an Averardo entry cannot be checked.

Grepped the 1955 MAP inventory (archive.org): MAP I nos. 89-207 and MAP II nos. 1, 375 are the letters received by Averardo and Piero as commissioners at Faenza, Jul-Dec 1425 (from the Dieci, Cosimo, Alamanno Salviati, other commissioners). None marked 'in cifra'. Possible siblings or a draft; not yet seen.

Tried the ASF image server (archiviodistatofirenze.cultura.gov.it, PAD and MAP) from the shell and the in-app browser: connection timed out, as did cultura.gov.it; the old archiviodistato.firenze.it host returns 410. Wayback holds the PAD pages but not the image tiles.

outcome.method_basis: The ciphertext is not reachable: no image of the 27 Oct 1425 letter is online (DECODE, Yale Ilardi reels, ASF image server all checked), and the printed copy omits the cipher.

gaps.item: the cipher part of the letter of 27 Oct 1425 ('Quanto più pensiamo ...' to the date)

outcome.notes: Blocked. Next: MAP I-II (Faenza commission letters) when the ASF server is back; order ASF photographs of Dieci di Balìa, Responsive, Oct-Nov 1425. DECODE corrections for R3758-R3789 queued.
